answer: A farm of 392 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are entered in jetty, queued in anchor, and comet publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 50 identities per epoch. A farm of 828 identities would post 506 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
